h1: China F visa (exchanges and non-business visits)

prices.included: Form completion, document check, visa centre appointment and submission support
Everything in Standard, with faster processing at the visa centre

intro: The China F visa is for non-commercial visits: exchanges, study tours, research and academic visits, and cultural, sports, educational or religious trips, at the invitation of a Chinese organisation. We complete your application, check your invitation letter and handle the visa centre submission.
eligibility: You're invited by a Chinese organisation for a non-commercial exchange or visit
The trip is not paid work, study on a course, or a business trip
Your passport is valid for at least six months, with two blank visa pages
If you are not British, you hold valid UK residence status

sections.heading: Do you need a China F visa?
sections.text: British passport holders can visit China visa-free for up to 30 days until 31 December 2026, and exchange visits are one of the allowed purposes. You need an F visa if your visit is longer than 30 days, you travel on another passport, or you travel after the visa-free policy ends and it isn't extended. Business trips use the M visa instead.

sections.heading: Documents for a China F visa
sections.text: You'll need an invitation letter from the Chinese organisation hosting you, with your details, the purpose and dates of the visit, where you'll stay and who pays. Some visits need an invitation from a duly authorised unit, which your host can arrange.

sections.heading: Groups, schools and universities
sections.text: We handle F visas for school trips, university delegations, sports teams and cultural groups, with one checklist per traveller and updates until all passports are back.

sections.heading: China visa help in Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers, families and businesses across the North West and the rest of the UK. Most China visa applications can be handled by post and email, so you only need to visit us if you want to. You can also collect your passport from our office at no extra cost.

title: China F Visa from the UK | Exchanges, Study Tours & Visits
description: China F visa help for UK residents on exchanges, study tours, research visits and cultural, educational or religious trips. Documents and fees.

faqs.q: What's the difference between the F visa and the M visa?
faqs.a: The M visa is for commercial activity such as meetings, trade fairs and buying. The F visa is for non-commercial visits like exchanges, study tours, research and cultural trips.

faqs.q: Can a school or university group apply together?
faqs.a: Yes. We regularly handle group applications and can collect documents from each traveller separately.

faqs.q: Do I need to attend the visa centre?
faqs.a: For a short stay (up to 180 days), usually not: until 31 December 2026 fingerprints are waived for short-term visas, so we can submit your application for you. Long-stay visas (stays over 180 days) still need fingerprints in person, and we book that appointment for you.

documentsTable.details: Original passport, valid for at least six months with two blank visa pages, plus a copy of the photo page
Completed and checked by us before submission
Recent colour photo on a white background, meeting Chinese visa specifications
From the Chinese host organisation, with the purpose, dates, accommodation and who pays
From your school, university or organisation, if you're travelling as part of a group
Your UK visa or eVisa share code, if you are not British
Copies of any previous Chinese visas
